name: Kou
source:
An artifact spirit.
He's strict about observing laws, he's very serious and hard working.
A classmate at the Chinju campus, he's leader of the guard platoon.
He's working hard to become the night watchman and [url=/c46476]Yoimiya's[/url] right hand man.
